profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer @ World Wide Technology
profile.summary:
Software engineer with expertise in developing Javascript applications that leverage React, Redux, Node.js/Express.js, TypeScript, and SQL/NoSQL databases. Additionally, I hold an AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and have led technical seminars on topics such as AWS services and UI/UX best practices.

My experience includes working with small teams, leading code reviews for junior engineers, and interviewing prospective engineers for my team. I am also an active contributor to open source projects and am a co-developer of OverVue 9.0, an open source Vue prototyping tool that exports boilerplate code ready for production.

As a Software Engineer for Codesmith, I played a vital role in preparing software engineers for mid-to-senior level positions. I have also been a featured speaker in JEENY and Bractlet Software Engineering Series on topics such as "React Router."

I am passionate about exploring new technologies and contributing to open source projects. If you want to connect or discuss anything related to software engineering, feel free to message me.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented React with React Hooks and dynamic and reusable components, maintaining codebase modularity and independent state management while establishing client-side routing with React Router, offering a smoother user experience by avoiding page reloads.

• Utilized WebSockets for real-time, bi-directional communication with reduced latency between the client and server.

• Leveraged a variety of AWS cloud services such as S3 for secure and scalable object storage, EC2 for elastic compute capacity, ECR for container registry, and Elastic Beanstalk for easy deployment and scaling of a web application.

• Employed Docker to containerize applications, optimizing images for enhanced scalability and maintainability, ensuring consistent performance across various development environments, and improving application scalability and maintainability in a platform-agnostic manner.

• Configured Webpack to optimize load time and application performance by enabling Hot Module Reloading for live reloading of modules and ES6+ transpiling for improved compatibility with older browsers, reducing development time and improving efficiency.

• Authored internal training materials in Webpack, Docker, Travis CI, and UI/UX best practices to help junior engineers optimize their workflows, improve application performance and scalability, and create effective and user-friendly interfaces.

• Mentored engineers on algorithmic best practices, system design concepts and implementing automated testing frameworks to improve code quality, reduce bugs, and increase confidence in code changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated over 2000 lines of JavaScript to TypeScript across OverVue’s components, enabling static typing and error-handling, improving codebase scalability and structure, and facilitating debugging and code readability across different teams.

• Built a dynamic and interactive front-end using Vue, applying atomic methodologies and functional paradigms to optimize reuse and modularization, leveraging Vue-Multiselect, and offering a robust virtual DOM.

• Deployed Pinia to handle state management, establishing a centralized store for application state based on the observer design pattern, and easing development via a trackable, event-based application state history.

• Converted Vue scripts from Options API to Composition API, allowing state to persist across the application and making use of functions without the need for prototype objects.
Compiled binaries to all major platforms using Electron’s Chromium engine and Quasar, making OverVue platform-agnostic.

• Increased OverVue's audience engagement on LinkedIn and Medium by 25%, resulting in 2400 stars on Github.

• Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io).

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Utilized test-driven development and Jest to ensure high quality and bug-free code in the design and implementation of a highly responsive, mobile-friendly user interface for the company's website using React, Node.js and Express.js.
• Improved communication with clients and staff by developing an automated email system using JavaScript and the Twilio API.
• Tracked client data and enhanced customer service by implementing a PostgreSQL database.
• Developed a customer-facing product list that met marine safety committee regulations using React and Node.js.
• Created custom APIs using Node.js and Express to seamlessly integrate website data with third-party software systems, resulting in a reduction in manual data entry.

honors.title: Raymond A. Smith Award for Scholarship
honors.description: My research paper which aimed to expose the mistreatment of black laborers in Mississippi Delta in 1927 by analyzing the lyrics of recorded blues songs was selected to win our department's scholarship in May.
honors.issuer: Issued by CWU College of Arts & Humanities · May 2014

projects.title: LazyBrew 2.0
projects.description:
• Integrated Google OAuth to enable secure login and personalized experiences without sensitive data sharing.

• Composed a PostgreSQL database to securely store user login credentials and email information, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality, and enabling the application to retrieve user information efficiently for personalization, leading to increased user retention and engagement.

projects.title: HomeHelper
projects.description:
• Implemented React Router to enhance UX in a mobile-first app by dynamically rendering single components and efficiently routing between them.

• Integrated OAuth authentication to secure user data and ensure secure communication between clients and servers.

• Designed and normalized an SQL database to efficiently store and manage data, ensuring ACID compliance and performing complex queries to reduce the total number of database requests required.

• Integrated the Twilio API to send automated text reminders to users based on their maintenance schedules, improving user engagement and reducing the risk of appliance failure.
